# SKU approval and publication form

Status: template. Approval is specific to SKU, version, destination, customer type and sourcing lane.

| Field | Response/evidence |
|---|---|
| Internal SKU and record owner | |
| Manufacturer, MPN, GTIN and applicable UDI | |
| Exact model/variant and sellable pack | |
| Unit/box/case quantities and order multiple | |
| Manufacturer intended purpose and intended user | |
| Product regime/class and classification rationale | |
| Sterile/measuring/invasive/reusable status where relevant | |
| Supplier and approved supply route | |
| Our role; manufacturer/representative/importer identities | |
| Declaration, certificate if applicable, labels and IFU | |
| Device/medicine/biocide registration/authorisation evidence as applicable | |
| Evidence issue/expiry dates and exact product scope | |
| Destination and customer eligibility | |
| Claims, warnings and content reviewer | |
| Image/data rights and translation version | |
| Compatibility and permitted accessories | |
| Lot/serial, expiry and minimum remaining shelf life | |
| Storage, chemical/SDS and transport class | |
| Weight, dimensions, freight/installation class | |
| Cost currency, FX assumption and landed cost | |
| VAT code and transaction-dependent relief conditions | |
| Price, quantity tiers and contribution checks | |
| Warehouse/supplier-direct/quotation source | |
| Availability freshness and delivery promise | |
| Warranty, servicing, calibration and spares | |
| Returns route and resale assessment | |
| Recall/complaint contacts | |
| Approval decision, reviewers and date | |
| Publication status by country/channel | |
| Change triggers and next review | |

Missing applicable evidence is a release blocker. A certificate not required for the actual route should be marked not applicable with rationale, not fabricated or requested as a universal checkbox.
